Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Eli_1: priest of Israel in Shiloh (1 Samuel 1:3)
Abner_1: captain of Saul's army and Saul's uncle (1 Samuel 14:50)
Achish_1: King of Gath (1 Samuel 21:10) before whom David feigned madness
Abiathar_1: son of Ahimelech, the priest (1 Samuel 22:20), counselor to David (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Zeruiah_1: mother of Abishai, Joab (1 Samuel 26:6), and Asahel (2 Samuel 2:18), sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Joab_1: son of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 2:13), commander of David's army (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Maoch_1: father of the king of Gath (1 Samuel 27:2)
Absalom_1: third-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:3)
Adonijah_1: fourth-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:4)
Zadok_1: son of Ahitub and priest during King David's reign (2 Samuel 8:17), a mighty of valor (1 Chronicles 12:28)
Benaiah_1: over the Cherethites and the Pelethites (2 Samuel 8:18), the fifth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:20)
Jehoiada_1: father of Benaiah (2 Samuel 8:18), a priest (1 Chronicles 27:5)
Bathsheba_1: daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah (2 Samuel 11:3)
Shimei_2: of the house of Saul (2 Samuel 16:5) who threw stones at King David
Gera_3: father of Shimei (2 Samuel 16:5), son of Bela (1 Chronicles 8:5)
Amasa_1: set over David's army in place of Joab (2 Samuel 17:25)
